description: This file defines the DailySpendUpdateQueue class, which manages an in-memory queue for daily spend update transactions, including methods for adding updates, aggregating them, and emitting events. It is part of a database transaction queue system for handling daily spend data.

classes.name: DailySpendUpdateQueue
classes.description: A class that manages an in-memory queue for daily spend updates, allowing addition, aggregation, and event emission related to daily spend transactions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DailySpendUpdateQueue with an asyncio queue.

methods.name: add_update
methods.description: Enqueues a new daily spend update and triggers aggregation if the queue exceeds max size.

methods.name: aggregate_queue_updates
methods.description: Aggregates all updates in the queue into a single update to reduce queue size.

methods.name: flush_and_get_aggregated_daily_spend_update_transactions
methods.description: Retrieves and aggregates all updates from the queue, returning the combined transactions.

methods.name: get_aggregated_daily_spend_update_transactions
methods.description: Static method that combines multiple daily spend updates into aggregated transactions by key.

methods.name: _emit_new_item_added_to_queue_event
methods.description: Emits an event indicating a new item has been added to the queue, for monitoring purposes.
